_note: Written by poll_error_fit.py from data/poll_error_history.csv. state_bias and global_bias are added to the poll margin (actual - poll).

race_bias._note: Candidate-specific poll miss added to a race's poll margin (+ = polls understate Dems, - = understate the GOP), e.g. an incumbent who runs ahead of polls. Race id -> points. ME-senate -2.0: Collins has beaten her polls in past races (2020 by about 11 pts); set to 0 to remove.
